summary: Of 54 author-selected genes, 23 had an unambiguous registered obesity-versus-control effect. Directions agreed for 22. M6pr-ps reversed from +2.65 in the paper to −0.101 in HypoExplorer. The comparison falls below the author-concordance-v2 minimum of 30 pairs and 90% selected-reference coverage. The proposal passed validation, and no ledger was edited. [Published tables](https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC13025380/#genes-17-00297-t001)
openIssues: The paper reports 393 obesity-associated DEGs. No registered gene passes FDR < 0.05. The full author DESeq2 table, per-gene P/FDR values and exact model inputs were unavailable to reconcile that difference.

Tables 1 and 2 report different obesity effects for Ppargc1b (−1.93 and −1.46). Table 1 was used because it identifies the full selected list by Ensembl ID. Using Table 2’s value leaves the direction count and closure decision unchanged.
